$comment: tests/e2e/api/runners/fixture-folders.mjs reads this file. notRun: harness folder files that use a fixture and that no runner group runs yet, each with its reason and ticket. quarantine: rows that a runner group runs and that fail on main, each with its ticket; the check fails when a quarantined row passes, so the entry must be removed in the PR that fixes the row. skippedRows: rows in a folder a group runs that skip themselves there on purpose (a live row in a fixture folder), each with the reason; any other row that no group answers fails the run, since it checked nothing. All three lists only shrink.
